nodes.text: Brother Cole. Fine morning. Like the good book probably says: the early bird gathers no moss.

choices.text: Pretty sure that's two different sayings.

nodes.speaker: Preacher Boone
nodes.text: Scripture works in bundles, brother. Saves paper.

nodes.speaker: Preacher Boone
nodes.text: That's the spirit. Whichever spirit it turns out to be.
